games.title: Power of Tiger

captions.help.slots.poweroftiger.symbols.descript: Symbol payouts are shown in the selected currency. Changing the bet amount proportionally adjusts the payout scale accordingly.
All symbols pay on active paylines from left to right on consecutive reels, beginning with the leftmost reel.

The WILD symbol substitutes for all symbols on active paylines.
It can appear on all reels. In the base game, whenever a full screen of the same symbol lands or all 5 active paylines form winning combinations, all wins are multiplied by one of the following multipliers selected at random: x5, x10, x15, or x20.
captions.help.slots.poweroftiger.page1.descriptio:
The RESPIN feature may trigger randomly on any spin. When activated, a random paying symbol is selected. At the beginning of the RESPIN, a multiplier of x5, x10, x15, or x20 is randomly selected and displayed.
The reels then spin and stop displaying only the selected symbol, any Wild symbols, and blank positions.
The reels will respin if additional symbols of the selected type or Wild symbols land. These symbols remain locked in place, and a new respin is awarded.
The RESPIN feature ends when no additional selected symbols land during a respin or when the entire screen is filled with the selected symbol and/or Wild symbols.

At the end of the RESPIN, if the screen is fully filled with the selected symbol, all wins are multiplied by the multiplier selected at the beginning of the RESPIN.
Respin winnings are awarded to the player after the round is completed.
captions.help.slots.poweroftiger.page2.descriptio: The game has 5 fixed active paylines.
All symbols pay from left to right on adjacent reels starting from the leftmost reel and only on active paylines. Line wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line.
Only the highest win per payline is paid. When winning on multiple paylines, all wins are added together to determine the total win.

Please note that after a disconnection, autoplay mode will be switched off to ensure a fair and enjoyable gaming experience. It is important to note that any malfunction will void all plays and payouts, and any unfinished round will be terminated.
If you are playing in autoplay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.

captions.help.slots.multifruitschargingwilds.symb: All symbols pay on active paylines from left to right on consecutive reels, beginning with the leftmost reel.

If a WILD symbol does not participate in a win, it remains on the grid and its multiplier increases by +1 on each new spin. captions.help.slots.multifruitschargingwilds.mult:

After each new spin in which the WILD symbol does not take part in a winning combination, its multiplier increases by +1 (for example, x2, x3, x4, and so on).
Your accumulated WILD Multiplier is linked to your chosen bet value. If you change your bet, the current WILD Multiplier is saved and will reactivate whenever you switch back to that specific betting value.
The WILD multiplier increases only when the WILD symbol does not participate in a winning combination. When the WILD symbol forms part of a winning combination, the win is paid and multiplied by the current WILD multiplier value.
If a winning combination occurs without the participation of a WILD symbol, that win is paid normally. (According to the paytable). A new spin then follows, and the WILD multiplier increases if the WILD symbol again does not form part of a winning combination.
Multiple WILD symbols may appear on the game grid at the same time. Any WILD symbol that participates in a winning combination is removed from the grid. WILD symbols that do not participate remain in place, and their multipliers increase by +1 on each new spin in which they do not form part of a winning combination.

Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However if the guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.

games.title: Gates of Merlyn

captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.symbols.descrip: Symbol payouts are shown in the selected currency. Changing the bet amount proportionally adjusts the payout scale accordingly. Symbols pay anywhere on the screen. The total number of identical symbols visible at the end of a spin determines the win amount. This game has no paylines.
captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.tumblefeature.d: The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every winning spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen, and the empty positions are replaced with new symbols coming from above.
Tumbling continues until no additional winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
These are the multiplier symbols. They appear on all reels and can land randomly during spins and tumbles in both the base game and FREE SPINS.

Whenever a MULTIPLIER symbol lands, it receives a random multiplier value of:
2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X, 10X, 15X, 20X, 30X, 40X, 50X, 100X, 250X, or 500X.
Blue multiplier possible values: 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X
Purple multiplier possible values: 10X, 15X, 20X, 30X, 40X
Red multiplier possible values: 50X, 100X, 250X, or 500X
When the tumbling sequence ends, the values of all MULTIPLIER symbols on the screen are added together, and the total win of the sequence is multiplied by that final value.
captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.specialsymbol.d: The MAGIC symbol represents Merlin’s magical orb. When it appears, one random symbol on the board is removed, and new symbols fall into place, increasing the chances of forming winning combinations.
This symbol activates only when no winning combination is present on the board.
There is no limit to the number of possible tumbles. All wins are added to the player's balance after all tumbles resulting from a base spin have been completed.
captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.buybonus.descri: The FREE SPINS FEATURE is awarded when 4 or more SCATTER symbols hit anywhere on the screen.

When 4 or more SCATTER symbols land, their payout is awarded according to the paytable. If there are any other winning symbol combinations on the same spin, they are also paid according to the paytable.
After all wins are paid, the Free Spins round begins.

The round starts with 15 free spins.

The combined multiplier value collected from all winning spins remains active until the end of the Free Spins round.
During the FREE SPINS round, whenever a MULTIPLIER symbol lands and the spin results in a win, its value is added to the total multiplier.
captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.freespins.descr: Landing 3 or more SCATTER symbols during the FREE SPINS ROUND awards 5 additional free spins, which are added to the current total

Throughout the entire round, any new MULTIPLIER symbol that appears and results in a win will also add its value to the total multiplier, and the accumulated multiplier is applied to multiply the win.
captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.antebet.descrip: The game features an Ante Bet option. When the player activates this feature, their base bet increases by 50% and the chance of triggering the bonus game increases by approximately 3 times.
The player can disable this feature at any time by pressing the Disable button.
captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.antebet2.descri:
When this option is purchased, 100x the current bet is deducted from the player's balance.
Since the bonus round is purchased, 4 or more SCATTER symbols are guaranteed to land, and their payout is awarded according to the paytable. If any other winning symbol combinations occur on the same spin, they are also paid according to the paytable.
After all wins are paid, the Free Spins round begins.

The round starts with 15 free spins.
All features of the regular Free Spins round remain active, and Free Spins follow the exact rules described above.
captions.help.slots.gatesofmerlyn.buybonus2.descr:
When this option is purchased, 500x the current bet is deducted from the player's balance.
Since the bonus round is purchased, 4 or more SCATTER symbols are guaranteed to land, and their payout is awarded according to the paytable. If any other winning symbol combinations occur on the same spin, they are also paid according to the paytable.
All features of the regular Free Spins round remain active, and Free Spins follow the exact rules described above.

The key difference in this version is the range of possible multiplier values.
During this type of Buy Bonus, the minimum multiplier that can appear is 10x.
Lower multipliers — 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x — do not appear during this type of Buy Bonus.

captions.help.slots.geniesbonanza.risk.game.descr:
The player has the option to select the bet multiplier. Depending on the selected bet, playing with B+ will always cost the player an extra 25% of their total bet. The added B+ value will not be taken into consideration when paying out on symbols, either in the basic or bonus game.
The B+ feature allows players to collect scatters received only during the base game. If a player collects 100 scatters during the same round, the player will trigger a free bonus game. B+ bet also has the ‘Risk’ game feature, which means that as soon as a player reaches 10% of the progress bar, they can play the ‘Risk’ game. The Risk game chance depends on the percentage of the progress bar.
When the Risk game is triggered, a wheel appears on the screen. Players can spin the wheel and if they hit a win, they will be awarded a Bonus game. If they hit a ‘lose’ they will return to the base game. After spinning the Risk game wheel, whether the player wins or loses, the progress bar will be reset.The cost of a Risk game spin is the same as the bet amount. If a player does not have enough money in their account, an error pop-up will appear asking them to add funds. After spinning the Risk game wheel, if the player loses, they will receive one extra spin in the base game. If the player wins the Risk game spin, they will receive a bonus winning spin in the base game.
If a player lands 4 or more scatters during the base game at the same time, the Genies progress bar will increase to 100% and the player will play 2 bonus games. The first will start automatically and after this, the second game begins.
By default, at the start of the game, the B+ button is always activated. If you choose to switch off this button, the Genie’s progress bar will disappear from the game screen.
captions.help.slots.geniesbonanza.scatter.descrip:
The bonus game feature triggers when 4 or more scatter symbols land anywhere on the screen. The round starts with 10 free spins. Whenever 3 or more scatter symbols land during the free spins round, 5 additional free spins are awarded.
During the bonus round, players can receive extra multiplier symbols that can land anywhere on the screen. Multiplier symbols are present on the reels only during the bonus game and they remain on the screen until the end of the current spin. Whenever a multiplier symbol lands, it will take a random value of:2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X, 10X, 12X, 15X, 18X, 20X, 25X, 30X, 40X, 50X, 60X, 80X, 90X or 100X.
When the spin ends, the value of all multiplier symbols on the screen are added together and the total win of that round is multiplied by the final value.
captions.help.slots.geniesbonanza.carpet.descript:
During the bonus free spins, players can randomly trigger the Genie’s Carpet feature. During this feature, before the start of spin, the genie’s carpet will fly across the screen and drop 4 or more special ‘?’ cloud symbols. After the feature ends, the “?” symbols will turn into the same random pay symbols. Additionally, random multipliers can also appear under the “?”.
At the end of this feature, a basic spin will start and fill the empty reels.
Players can instantly start the bonus game using the ‘Bonus Buy’ button. This will cost 100x your base bet value.

After every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with symbols falling from above. The spins will continue until there are no more winning combinations. All wins are added to the player’s balance at the end of spin.
Symbols pay anywhere. All wins are multiplied by your base bet. When winning with multiple symbols, all wins are added to your total win.

games.title: Dragon's Code

captions.help.slots.dragonscode.multiplier.reel.d: Dragon's Code" is an enchanting 50-payline slot that invites players into a mystical world inspired by the majesty of elves. The game offers a thrilling Re-spin bonus feature, as well as a Re-spin Buy option for those seeking extra chances to win. With captivating graphics and immersive gameplay, this slot brings the allure of the elven realm to life

Before each spin, a random multiplier (ranging from 1X to 5X) is chosen on an extra multiplier reel. Any wins during the spin, as well as wins from bonus re-spins, will be boosted by this selected multiplier, enhancing the excitement and potential rewards.

The Bonus Re-spin feature in Dragon's Code gives players a chance to collect selected symbols during re-spins for bigger wins. The feature ends when no additional re-spin symbols appear, and winnings are calculated at the end. Here are the ways to activate it:
During the base game, if 4 matching symbols land on reel 1 and a Wild symbol appears on any other reel, the re-spin feature starts (excluding full-screen wins).

After a base game spin, a Golden Egg symbol can randomly trigger the feature by breaking the dragon's nest, filling the 1st reel with dragon symbols, which transform into matching symbols to start the re-spin.
This option allows players to buy a re-spin with a randomly selected symbol for 25X the bet size.
For 40X the bet size, players can buy a re-spin featuring one of the top 4 symbols.
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.double.gamble.des: Players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “x2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However, if they guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.payline.headline: PAYLINES AND RULES
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.payline.descripti: Winning combinations form by landing matching symbols on adjacent reels, following selected paylines from left to right, starting from the leftmost reel. Scatter wins are combined with payline wins, and only the highest payline and/or scatter wins are awarded. Line/Scatter wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line, along with the value from the Multiplier reel.
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.buttons.2x.choose: open the menu, and choose your bet.
captions.help.slots.dragonscode.other.rules.descr:
Disconnection: In the event of a disconnection during gameplay, all accepted bets will still be played out, and any resulting wins will be credited to the player’s balance at the end of the round. Please note that after a disconnection, autoplay mode will be switched off to ensure a fair and enjoyable gaming experience. It’s important to note that any malfunction will void all plays and payouts, and any unfinished round will be terminated.

When you hit the winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, use the take win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 double up feature button and click take win. If you are playing in autoplay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.

games.title: Book of Bonanza

captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.objects.book: Book symbol plays as a wild and 4+ scatters will trigger bonus round.
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.payline.rules.d: Prizes are awarded for matching combinations of symbols. Combinations must appear from left to right on a line, except for scatters. Only the highest win on each line and for each scatter combination is paid. Scatter wins and line wins are combined. The paytable displays prizes for the currently selected bet amount. Book Scatter symbols can substitute any paying symbol during the game
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.bonus.feature.d:
4 or more book scatters on the screen trigger 10 free games with a special expanding symbol. The special expanding symbol cannot be substituted by a scatter symbol during Free games.
One special expanding symbol is randomly selected at the start of the Free games. During Free Games and after the payout of regular symbols, the special symbol may expand to cover 3 positions on the reel and pays like the regular symbol, even on non-adjacent positions and on all lines played (expanding is only triggered if enough symbols for a win are present).
Every time a player hits 3 or more Book scatter symbols during Free games, they will win an extra 10 Free spins, and the expanding bonus symbol will remain the same.
Players can use the Buy Bonus Feature to buy the Free Games Round at a specified price.
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.B+.feature.head: B+ BET Feature Guide:
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.B+.feature.desc: Activate or deactivate the Bonus Bet feature using the B+ button in the game lobby. Enabling this feature incurs an additional cost of 25% of the total bet. Note that the added B+ value does not impact symbol payouts in both the basic and bonus games
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.B+.feature.guid: The B+ feature lets players accumulate scatters exclusively during the base game. Upon collecting 100 scatters at a specific bet amount, players automatically trigger a free bonus game. The B+ feature also introduces the "Bonus Gamble" option. When the B+ Progress Bar reaches 10%, players can engage in the Gamble game. The outcome, whether a win or lose, is determined by the progress bar percentage.
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.riskgame.featur: During the Bonus Risk game, a wheel appears on the screen. Spinning the wheel can result in either a winning green sector, awarding a Free Bonus Game, or a losing red sector, leading players back to the base game. Regardless of the outcome, the progress bar is reset after each Bonus Risk game spin.

The cost of a Bonus Risk game spin aligns with the bet amount used to accumulate Progress Bar percentages. If a player lacks sufficient funds, an error pop-up prompts them to add funds. Losing in the Bonus Risk game grants an extra spin in the base game, while winning rewards players with a bonus-winning spin.
Landing 4+ Scatters during the base game triggers the bonus game immediately — it does not add to the B+ Progress Bar. The Progress Bar fills separately from base game events and, at 100%, triggers its own single bonus game.
